review_candidates.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Officer
review_candidates.description: Company Description SQUARE Engineering Firm (Square S.A.E) is an Egyptian joint-stock company founded in 1992, specializing in distinguished architectural and contracting projects. The firm partners with experienced consultants and architects, supported by a team of committed associates and founders with deep industry expertise. Its specialized technical office brings extensive knowledge of both local and international markets, strengthening project execution and innovation. This integrated network of know-how enables SQUARE to consistently meet technical standards and timeline commitments. Professionals joining the firm can expect a collaborative, growth-oriented environment focused on high-quality project delivery. Role Description The Senior Talent Acquisition Officer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt, responsible for leading end-to-end recruitment activities for SQUARE Engineering Firm. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with hiring managers to understand workforce needs, developing accurate and inclusive job descriptions, and designing effective sourcing strategies to attract qualified talent. The role involves screening applications, conducting structured interviews, coordinating selection processes, and ensuring a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey. The Senior Talent Acquisition Officer will also maintain recruitment metrics, support employer branding initiatives, and ensure hiring practices align with company policies and local labor regulations. This position works closely with HR and leadership to build a sustainable talent pipeline that supports the firm’s ongoing projects and strategic objectives. Qualifications Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders. Proficiency in job description development, including defining role requirements and ensuring clarity, inclusivity, and alignment with organizational needs. Demonstrated experience in recruiting and hiring, including sourcing, shortlisting, and managing the full recruitment lifecycle for technical and non-technical roles. Skilled in conducting structured interviews and assessments, using fair and consistent evaluation methods to select suitable candidates. Previous experience in talent acquisition, ideally within engineering, construction, or related industries. Knowledge of recruitment best practices, labor laws, and compliance standards in Egypt. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and deadlines. Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HR software, and common productivity tools (e.g., MS Office). Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; relevant HR or recruitment certifications are an advantage. Ability to work on-site in Cairo and collaborate in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

review_candidates.title: Junior Subsea Production Engineer Egypt
review_candidates.description: ISS International S.p.A. is looking for a Junior Mechanical Engineer to join an Oil & Gas Project based in New Cairo, Egypt, in the position of Junior Subsea Production Engineer. The opportunity is intended for a junior engineer with a Mechanical Engineering background , who will be assigned to and develop within the Subsea Production Engineering discipline. The selected candidate will support the project engineering team in activities related to subsea production systems , including technical documentation review, engineering coordination and technical support to mechanical equipment and systems associated with subsea production facilities. The position is mainly office-based in New Cairo , with possible short-term surveys and technical activities on offshore platforms in Egypt. Here below you can find the main details: Position: Junior Subsea Production Engineer; Required Background: Junior Mechanical Engineer; Location: New Cairo, Egypt + possible surveys/missions to offshore platforms; Expected Starting Date: 01/11/2026; Duration: until 30/11/2027, with high probability of extension; Working Schedule: 8 hours/day, 5 days/week; Rotation: N/A – Resident position; Contract: Consultant Agreement with ISS International S.p.A., Rome, Italy. Candidates should have a Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline . Previous academic, internship or professional exposure to mechanical systems, piping, valves, production equipment, offshore facilities, subsea systems or Oil & Gas projects will be considered an advantage, but previous subsea experience is not necessarily required for the position. BOSIET certification is required for offshore activities. Candidates who do not currently hold a valid BOSIET must be willing to obtain it; the related documented expenses will be reimbursed by ISS International S.p.A. The ideal candidate should have good analytical and communication skills, willingness to develop professionally within the Subsea Production Engineering discipline and availability to participate in offshore platform surveys and project-related site activities when required.

review_candidates.title: Internal Communications Manager
review_candidates.description: Overview We Are PepsiCo PepsiCo is a leading name in North Africa’s food and beverage industry, where our products are enjoyed by consumers daily across the region. We offer a robust portfolio of beloved brands like PEPSI, SEVEN-UP, DORITOS, CHEETOS and CHIPSY, designed to cater to the tastes and preferences of consumers. With a focus on local sourcing, production, and distribution, PepsiCo provides essential support to local economies and partners closely with communities throughout the region. Guiding Vision and Regional Impact PepsiCo’s vision aligns with our global goal to be the Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+). This strategic transformation is committed to sustainable growth by putting people and the planet at the heart of our operations. In North Africa, this includes initiatives in responsible sourcing, waste reduction, and water conservation. Our regional programs empower local talent, boost employment, and provide support for local agriculture, particularly through partnerships with farmers and suppliers. Empowering Our People and Communities Our dynamic teams drive the PepsiCo culture in North Africa, embracing diversity and collaboration to solve local challenges and create innovative products. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace, one where every individual feels valued and empowered to be themselves. This commitment extends beyond our employees to positively impact the communities we serve, striving for shared growth and a healthier, more sustainable future for all. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment PepsiCo stands firmly behind our global commitment to diversity, equality, and human rights. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, ensuring a fair and welcoming workplace for all, regardless of age, gender, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. Our dedication to inclusion strengthens our workforce and helps drive our business forward, enriching both PepsiCo and the communities in North Africa. Responsibilities Lead the internal communications agenda by designing and implementing effective communication strategies, systems, and engagement initiatives. Ensure timely, accurate, and consistent communication across all employee groups, leveraging appropriate communication channels to enhance engagement and organizational pride. Serve as a trusted communications advisor to the leadership team. Drive clear, timely, and impactful communication with frontline employees to keep them informed, engaged, and aligned with business priorities. Develop and execute a structured annual engagement calendar across all locations, ensuring consistency, quality, and impact of celebrations and employee events. Manage and track the Internal Communications budget. Identify executive speaking opportunities and develop speeches, presentations, briefing materials, and leadership communications. Partner with People Business Partners and key stakeholders to assess communication needs and design targeted communication solutions. Lead the planning and execution of communication initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment, resource coordination, and successful implementation. Own the end-to-end delivery of quarterly Town Halls, including message development, stakeholder alignment, agency management (where applicable), and event execution. Lead the planning and execution of year-end celebrations and other large-scale employee engagement events. Manage and continuously enhance communication channels and platforms, including LCD screens, internal communication mailboxes, SMS communications, and other employee touchpoints. Act as the communications lead for major business initiatives requiring large-scale employee communication, developing key messages, FAQs, and leader communication toolkits. Lead the cascade of regional and global communications through appropriate channels and platforms. Partner with Global Internal Communications, Digital Media, and Public Relations teams to ensure alignment between internal and external communication strategies. Conduct employee surveys and focus groups to identify communication needs, analyze insights, and develop action plans. Support crisis communication management by proactively developing communication plans, mitigating reputational risks, and ensuring leadership alignment during urgent situations. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Management, Economics, Social Sciences, Communications, or a related field. 10–12 years of relevant experience in internal communications, corporate communications, public relations, or a similar role within the private or public sector. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and public relations skills. Excellent strategic thinking, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English. Highly proactive, adaptable, and able to navigate ambiguity and complexity effectively. Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and work effectively with senior leaders and executives. Proven ability to leverage existing resources and drive process efficiencies. Strong creativity, innovation mindset, and digital communication capabilities. Ability to develop practical, impactful communication solutions that support business objectives.
